name: Adelaide Gaol
scope: Standing Adelaide Gaol, including the Georgian front range and arched double door, outer and inner walls, two historic masonry towers, the radial cell blocks and prison yards.
era: Standing former Adelaide Gaol and its later historic extensions

references.caption: Cropped image of the Main Entrance to Adelaide Gaol.
references.alt: Cropped image of the Main Entrance to Adelaide Gaol.

originalReview.notes: The red-brick central entrance has a broad sandstone arch ring with alternating voussoirs, a pale studded double door, black hinges, a fan of lettering and an armorial panel above the crown.

review.method: Exact already-published Qualla author-dedicated public-domain photo
review.notes: The exact published Qualla main entrance photograph has a creator public-domain dedication. The other Commons tower and cell block photos use attribution and share-alike licenses and were excluded. Exterior elevations outside the door photo use mapped controls and documented architectural facts.
